research.title: Negation-Sensitive Transfer for Textual Entailment
bullets: Formulated whether negation sensitivity transfers across text domains, and developed a contrastive training objective using meaning-preserving and polarity-reversing sentence edits.
Designed controlled evaluations separating lexical overlap from logical polarity, and analyzed prediction errors against standard entailment fine-tuning baselines.

research.title: Evidence Attribution and Selective Answering in Retrieval-Augmented Question Answering
bullets: Investigated when retrieved passages support generated answers, and led development of evidence-aware training combining passage attribution with contrastive supervision.

Developed evidence-perturbation evaluations and attribution-based abstention criteria; compared retrieval conditions, inspected unsupported answers, and conducted ablations of supervision and calibration components.

work.title: Data Import Validation and Service Maintenance
bullets: Implemented assigned validation checks for tabular data imports, handling missing fields, malformed values, and duplicate records within an existing service.
Added regression tests for reported import failures, reproduced defects from application logs, and documented error-handling behavior for maintenance handoffs.

projects.title: Comparing Sparse and Dense Retrieval for Document Search
bullets: Implemented term-weighted retrieval and pretrained sentence-embedding retrieval over a shared document collection, using identical query sets and relevance annotations.
Compared ranking quality and retrieval latency, and categorized disagreements involving rare terminology, paraphrased queries, and documents containing overlapping vocabulary.

projects.title: Sequence Labeling Methods for Named Entity Recognition
bullets: Implemented a conditional random field tagger and a bidirectional recurrent tagger, applying consistent tokenization and entity-label conventions across experiments.
Compared entity-level precision and recall, examined boundary errors and unseen names, and evaluated sensitivity to capitalization features and training-data subsampling.

projects.title: Probability Calibration for Sentiment Classification
bullets: Implemented linear and neural sentiment classifiers with shared dataset splits, then applied temperature scaling to held-out validation predictions.
Compared classification accuracy, calibration error, and reliability diagrams; inspected confidence patterns for ambiguous reviews, negation, and mixed sentiment.
